## TemplateEngine.\_processGSwitchBlocks() method

Block: g-switch Transforms `<g-switch>` blocks into JavaScript switch statement expressions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGSwitchBlocks(template: string): string;
```

The template with `<g-switch>` blocks converted to executable switch expressions

## Remarks

This internal method converts `<g-switch>` blocks with `<g-case>` and `<g-default>` sub-blocks into self-invoking JavaScript switch expressions. The `value` attribute specifies which data key to switch on. Case values can be comma-separated for multiple matches.

\*\*Attributes:\*\*  - <g-switch>  - `value` (required): The key name in the `data` object whose value will be used as the switch expression.  - <g-case>  - `is` (required): One or more literal match values. Multiple values may be provided as a comma-separated list.  - <g-default>  - none

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <g-switch value="status">
    <g-case is="active">Active status</g-case>
    <g-case is="pending">Pending status</g-case>
    <g-default>Unknown status</g-default>
  </g-switch>
`;
const processed = TemplateEngine._processGSwitchBlocks(template);
// Result: '${(() => { switch((data && data["status"])) { case "active": return `Active status`; ... } })()}'
```
